hyperedges.label: Company-scoped customer entities sharing companyOwner access

nodes.label: Predefined Entity-Specific Responses (newResponse)
nodes.rationale: Response implements error so it can be returned directly; message guidelines 'Please enter valid X', 'X not found', 'X already exists'.

nodes.label: Steps for New Entity (Model, DTO, Repository, Service, Responses, Handler, Routes, Wiring)
nodes.norm_label: steps for new entity (model, dto, repository, service, responses, handler, routes, wiring)

nodes.label: Uniform JSON Response Format (statusCode, success, message, data)
nodes.norm_label: uniform json response format (statuscode, success, message, data)

nodes.label: response.SendResponse
nodes.rationale: Any non-Response error becomes a 500 and is logged, so internals never reach the client.

nodes.label: Concrete Repository Structs Over Interfaces
nodes.rationale: Interfaces add complexity without benefit in 99% of cases; concrete types are simpler to test.

nodes.label: Repository -> Response Error Mapping
nodes.rationale: Prevents leaking implementation details (clients should not know PostgreSQL is used); actionable messages.

nodes.label: Soft Delete is Non-Negotiable
nodes.rationale: Audit trails, recovery, compliance; unique indexes include WHERE is_deleted = false.

nodes.label: Concrete Types Over Interfaces
nodes.rationale: YAGNI

nodes.label: Tech Stack (Go, PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB, pgx/v5, Air)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (go, postgresql + timescaledb, pgx/v5, air)

nodes.label: Air as go.mod Tool (hot reload)
nodes.rationale: Version pinned for everyone and downloaded automatically.

nodes.label: GOARCH=386 Pitfall
nodes.rationale: Builds 32-bit binaries and puts tools in go\bin\windows_386 where the terminal cannot find them.

nodes.label: VS Code Debugging with Delve (launch.json configs)
nodes.norm_label: vs code debugging with delve (launch.json configs)

nodes.label: README Layered Layout (Node.js analogy)
nodes.rationale: Same idea as Node.js projects: routes -> controller -> service -> db; standard library only.

nodes.label: Dependency Direction (inward) and Unidirectional Data Flow
nodes.norm_label: dependency direction (inward) and unidirectional data flow

nodes.label: Layered Architecture is Sacred
nodes.rationale: Separation enables testing, mocking and independent evolution; prevents circular dependencies.

nodes.label: Strict Layered Architecture (Handler -> Service -> Repository -> Model)
nodes.rationale: Request flow routes -> middleware -> handler -> dto.Validate -> service -> repository -> db; no layer skipping.
nodes.norm_label: strict layered architecture (handler -> service -> repository -> model)

nodes.label: Nullable Columns Must Use COALESCE
nodes.rationale: Eliminates nil pointer panics and null values in JSON responses.

nodes.label: Company Scoping (companyOwner / ownCompanyCustomer)
nodes.rationale: A customer is a company; members have users.company_id = the customer; other companies' rows answer 404.

nodes.label: Role Route Guards (superAdminOnly, managersOnly)
nodes.rationale: Role and company always come from the session (middleware.Authenticate reads them from the database), never from the request.

nodes.label: Shared Master Data (branches, categories, products, brands, controllers, models)
nodes.norm_label: shared master data (branches, categories, products, brands, controllers, models)

nodes.label: auth_tokens SHA-256 Hashed Sessions (migration 014)
nodes.rationale: A database leak gives no usable sessions.

nodes.label: Create Customer in One Transaction (user, company profile, user profile, address)
nodes.norm_label: create customer in one transaction (user, company profile, user profile, address)

nodes.label: Login Lockout (5 wrong passwords, 15 min, 429)
nodes.rationale: Unknown usernames take as long as wrong passwords to avoid username enumeration.

nodes.label: ts_session Cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict)
nodes.rationale: remember:true keeps 30 days, otherwise browser-session cookie ended after 12 hours; token never in response body.

nodes.label: Holidays API (holidays and week offs, migration 020)
nodes.norm_label: holidays api (holidays and week offs, migration 020)

nodes.label: Licence Keys API (migrations 024-025)
nodes.rationale: Keys from dto.LicenceKeyAlphabet (no I/O/0/1) via crypto/rand; duration plan codes M1..M12, Y1..Y3, LIFETIME, TRIAL, TRIAL_1Y; expires_on stored, isExpired computed.

nodes.label: Production Schedules API (migration 026)
nodes.rationale: Replaces old production_schedule / schedule_items; jobs must lie inside shift, not overlap, one schedule per machine per day.

nodes.label: User Form Field to Table Mapping
nodes.norm_label: user form field to table mapping

nodes.label: Database Queries are Sacred (no N+1, pooling, short transactions)
nodes.norm_label: database queries are sacred (no n+1, pooling, short transactions)

nodes.label: Never Trust Input (prepared statements, no sensitive logging)
nodes.norm_label: never trust input (prepared statements, no sensitive logging)

nodes.label: Validation at the Boundary (DTO Validate)
nodes.rationale: Fail fast, reusable validation, single source of truth testable in isolation.

nodes.label: Child Collection Sync (keep / add / soft-delete by id)
nodes.norm_label: child collection sync (keep / add / soft-delete by id)

nodes.label: Customer Display Names (customerName, companyName)
nodes.rationale: companyName comes from company_profiles.user_id, not users.company_id (only set on members).
